hook: Ethan Mollick is an associate professor at the Wharton School of the University of Pennsylvania, where he studies how AI changes work, entrepreneurship and education and co-directs the Generative AI Labs. His book Co-Intelligence: Living and Working with AI, published by Portfolio in 2024, became a New York Times bestseller. Before academia he co-founded the software company eMeta.

quick_facts: Associate Professor at the Wharton School since June 2009, according to his LinkedIn profile
Ralph J. Roberts Distinguished Faculty Scholar and Rowan Fellow at Wharton
Co-director of the Generative AI Labs at Wharton

Author of Co-Intelligence: Living and Working with AI (Portfolio, April 2024), which his publisher lists as a New York Times bestseller and a Best Book of the Year from The Economist and the Financial Times
Named among TIME's most influential people in AI, per his profile
PhD and MS/MBA from MIT Sloan and a BA from Harvard
